% Styles must leave references and contents plain and honor later memoir hooks.
\documentclass[a5paper,oneside,openany]{bookbangla}
\setbanglamainfont{Kalpurush}
\newcommand\testsectionstyle[1]{%
  \clearpage
  \bookbanglasetup{section-style=#1}
  \setcounter{section}{0}
  \section[Short title]{গণনার নানা পদ্ধতি এবং পায়রার খোপ নীতির প্রয়োগ}
  \label{sec:#1}
  Heading followed by body text. See \ref{sec:#1}.
  \subsection{পরের ধাপ}
  The subsection keeps its ordinary format.
  \section*{একটি দীর্ঘ নম্বরহীন পরিচ্ছেদ এবং তার নিচের লেখা}
  Unnumbered heading followed by body text.}
\begin{document}
\mainmatter
\setcounter{chapter}{1}
\tableofcontents*
\testsectionstyle{modern}
\testsectionstyle{ruled}
\testsectionstyle{minimal}
\testsectionstyle{classic}
\testsectionstyle{default}
\makeatletter
\ifx\secheadstyle\bookbangla@memoirsecheadstyle\else
  \errmessage{bookbangla-test-failed: memoir section font not restored}
\fi
\ifx\@seccntformat\bookbangla@memoirsecnumformat\else
  \errmessage{bookbangla-test-failed: memoir section numbers not restored}
\fi
\makeatother
\setsecheadstyle{\large\itshape}
\setsecnumformat{CUSTOM: \csname the#1\endcsname\quad}
\section{লেখকের পছন্দ}
Later memoir commands take precedence.
\end{document}
